主要内容: On January 23, 2015, Royal Bank of Canada announced its intention to acquire City National Corporation, a premier U.S. private and commercial bank. The acquisition was formalized through an agreement and plan of merger dated January 22, 2015. This move is part of Royal Bank of Canada's strategy to expand its presence in the U.S. market. The transaction is expected to enhance the bank's capabilities in serving private and commercial clients in the United States. The deal reflects the growing trend of international banks seeking to strengthen their foothold in the U.S. financial sector. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approvals and other customary conditions. This strategic move underscores the importance of cross-border banking partnerships in the evolving financial landscape.
